propositions: Integrate task-decomposition SOTA recommendations R1-R7 into plan-review gate with eval-based validation rather than A/B testing, using advisory-first posture and standing dogfood monitoring via R7 instrumentation.

Each recommendation R1-R7 is gated by its own falsifiable experiment (E1/E2/E3/E5/E6; E4 dropped) with thresholds in Acceptance Criteria; failed or ambiguous results block dependent R-stories with one documented re-run maximum per INCONCLUSIVE-GATE RULE.

Advisory-first implementation strategy: R1/R3/R4 ship as non-blocking criteria, pass bounded sanity checks, and are monitored by d8a5's standing effectiveness recorder; promotion to blocking posture requires accumulated dogfood evidence (blocking-FP proxy <10% threshold).

E1 outcome corpus (628 rows, event-mined) is frozen and committed; E2/E3 expensive LLM batch baseline permanently rejected on cost and superseded by d8a5's zero-LLM criterion_effectiveness.py sidecar; finding-adjudication/inter-rater-κ corpus descoped due to labeling contamination.

All validated changes land directly in packaged registry without config-flag overlay; R7 instrumentation measures blocking-FP rates against E1 ground truth; advisory→blocking demotion threshold documented in docs/plan-review-gate.md.

Sequencing: R7+R6 land first (instrumentation + deterministic no-gate move), then R2 (det_floor.py static check), then R1/R3/R4 serially (criteria_routing.json impacts); R5 coordinates IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION bump with floor-split story to avoid corpus segment conflicts.
